items.text: 1 Purpose and scope / 目的和适用范围 1 Purpose and scope / 目的和适用范围 This CT QR shall be effective for SSME CT where the QMM [6] is applicable. 本程序适用于在质量管理手册 [6]适用范围内的 SSME CT。 It regulates the procedure for planning, R&D, management and further development of systems, sub-systems, system components and services and purchases included therein. It describes the general guidelines and typical requirements, which must be observed for all R&D projects. 本程序规定了对系统、子系统、系统 组件进行 计划、技术开发及管理/进一步开发的程序，维 修和采购也包含在内。 本指令还对所有技术开 发项目必须遵守的总方针以及典型需求作了说 明。 Depending on the particular project circumstances, these data can be adapted to requirements, as long as this does not run counter to the basic principle of the CT QR (tailoring is to be described in the QMP) 只要不违背质量保证程序基本原则， 本规定可以 根据项目的特殊情况进行修改以适合具体的需 求(调整和裁剪 – 在质量管理计划中描述)。 For technical advancements, for example, the formal M120 and M150 decisions may be omitted if all the required design input documents are present. 比如，对于进一步技术开发，只要提交所有所需 的设计输入文件，可以省略正式 M120 和 M150

Page 19 of 54 12/10/2025 - 19 - Design Output Design output means the results of a design effort at each design phase and at the end of the total design effort. The finished design output consists of the device, its packaging and labeling, and the device master record. The development output is defined and documented in a form that facilitates an adequate evaluation of conformance to design input Design and development outputs shall: a. meet the input requirements for design and development; minimum: test summary reports b. provide appropriate information for purchasing, production and service provision; minimum: design transfers to suppliers (e.g. purchasing information), production and service c. contain or reference product acceptance criteria; minimum: design review records d. specify the characteristics of the product that are essential for its safe and proper use. minimum: general safety and performance requirements (according to Medical Device Regulation, former Medical Device Directive): essential requirement document The outputs of design and development shall be in a form suitable for verification against the design and development inputs and shall be approved prior to release to customer. Records of the design and development outputs shall be maintained.

At integration points components are integrated into subsystem and subsystems are integrated into the system. Software subsystems are defined and created according to [39], embedded and approved in the system project (delivery release). 产品开发在项目中进行, 从第一阶段“想法征集” 开始。 在集成点，组件被集成到子系统和子系统被集成到 系统中。 软件子系统根据[39] 定义和创建，被嵌入 并批准在系统项目(交付发布)中。 The design reviews pR DF, pR IR, pR SF only occur if hardware / eSW are developed. items.text: 5.3.2 Process Phase 2: Product Definition / 过程阶段 2：产品定义 o Do a market survey to analyze, amongst others, the potential and structure of the market (market volume, homogeneity, accessibility) and target groups (segmentation), o By analyzing and defining the key success factors of the new product, the potential and structure of the market (market volume, homogeneity, accessibility), the target groups (segmentation), its strengths, and weaknesses as well as restrictions of the organization. o Take into consideration existing strategic technology roadmaps as well as predefined strategies to create synergies. o 更有效的产品和系统需求定义。 • 产品策略：（推荐通过以下定义） o 做市场调查，分析市场潜力和结构（市 场容量，均匀性，可及性）和目标群体 （市场划分） 。 o 分析和定义新产品的关键成功因素，市 场潜力和结构（市场容量、同质性、可 接近性） ，以及目标群体（市场细分） ， 优势和劣势，以及该组织的限制。 o 统筹考虑现有的战略技术路线图，以及 预定义的策略，以创造协同效应。 • If necessary, feasibility tests, studies, and technology developments are carried out, and industrial design (only if hardware system is developed) is clarified. Results from these activities may be described in a system implementation concept. items.text: 5.3.2 Process Phase 2: Product Definition / 过程阶段 2：产品定义 • Product risks are identified and assessed and documented in the risk analysis; action plans to reduce the risk are defined (see [8]). • 识别和评估产品风险； 定义降低风险的行 动计划（见[8]）并在风险分析中记录。 • Identify and evaluate potential security risks for the product: threat and risk analysis. • 识别和评估产品潜在的安全风险：威胁与 风险分析。 • Determine security requirements: security requirement specification • 确定安全要求：安全需求规范。 • Determine device classification for target markets (e.g. EU MDR and EU AI Act) • 确定目标市场的设备分类 （EU MDR和EU AI Act）。 • Plan tests for verification and validation: test concept • 规划验证确认测试：测试概念 • Plan clinical development and - evaluation: clinical development plan, clinical evaluation plan • 规划临床开发和评估：临床开发计划，临 床评估计划。 • Assess claims and plan evidence: (initial) claim list • 评估声明并规划证据：（初始） 声明清单。 • Technical feasibility/prototyping (e.g. Engineering samples) and the possible reuse of existing components is assessed. • 对技术可行性/原形 （如工程样品） 和对现 有组件的可能重用进行评估。 • Decisions are taken on whether the development is going to be in-house and/or carried out by third parties; this includes selection of suppliers (see [2]). • 决定是否由内部和/或第三方执行开发； 包 括选择供应商（见[2]）。 • Strategic procurement must be involved as early as possible to follow-up on the supplier technologies at the best, and to optimize the cost position for the development process. • The Early Procurement Involvement (EPI) and Early Supplier Involvement (ESI) is required, or when design decisions must be agreed with suppliers。 • 战略采购必须尽早介入，以便及时跟进供 应商技术，并优化整个开发过程的成本结 构。 • 需要早期采购参与（EPI）和早期供应商参 与（ESI） ， 或者当设计决策必须与供应商 达成一致时。 • Planning is carried out for country-specific approvals; requirements arising from standards and statutory provisions (S&L) are identified and reviewed.
